review_description: Of the three suppliers you advised one rang within a day, I think it was csa solar, one of the others rang after about 7 days and the other rang after about a week and a half. The first chap was very helpful and gave me a lot of good information, the other two were too late in contacting me as a deal had been done by this time.

This supplier has been good at communicating with me, from the contact in the office, through to the installer on site. I felt their quote was comprehensive and clear and that they knew what they are talking about. The installer was professional, delivered good work and delivered on time and to budget.All round, I would recommend them to anyone.You may use my reference with my first name only (last name is probably the only one in Qld
The chosen company were interested in my needs, quick to reply and followed up each of my calls and inquiries. Price was an issue but they were not the cheapest.
They did a great job. All wiring through the ceiling, no mess on the roof. Very neat and tidy job. Pleasant to deal with, on time and good tradesmen.

Nothing was any problem for the salesperson, and I asked some fairly silly questions. They visited our home twice before the installation took place. First to discuss and the second to take photos, measure and check our metre box etc.

Five Star Power Pty Ltd's owner Noel Fordyce would have to be the tidyest Electrician around. They even vacuumed the roof after drilling through the iron. Very happy with my set up as I have a 3.6 kw inverter installed that allows the future upgrade of additional panels when I can afford it.

There is alot of information about solar power however I found it very difficult to know which products are of good quality.  Quotes we recieved also varied greatly which made it very difficult to compare.  After some time and effort we have finally gone with one of the companies you suggested to us. Thank you.
